tagline: Inventing to connect people, technology and nature
hero_kpi_rationale: Legrand demonstrates a solid and increasing operational profitability trajectory (19.8% in 2024, +0.6 pts YoY), reflecting the effectiveness of its business model, cost discipline, and post-acquisition synergies. This indicator captures the value created by the group better than generic technology sector KPIs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying the direct costs of production.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved slightly in 2024, supported by operational efficiency gains and a better product mix.
kpis.signal: Stability and slight improvement in gross margin despite cost inflation.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before interest and taxes, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved due to cost discipline and post-acquisition synergies.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development relative to revenue.
kpis.description: R&D levels remain stable, focused on incremental innovation and digital integration of products.
kpis.signal: Moderate R&D typical of electrical equipment suppliers, no major technological leap.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or upgrade physical assets such as factories or equipment.
kpis.description: Capex increased in 2024, driven by automation projects and industrial site decarbonization.
kpis.signal: Rising capex to modernize factories and strengthen local production.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: The total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Headcount increased slightly, with targeted hiring in digital R&D and commercial functions.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount growth, driven by emerging markets and digital initiatives.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: The total amount of sales generated by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue grew in 2024, supported by resilient demand in commercial buildings and data centers.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth, driven by digital solutions and emerging markets.

risks.title: Increased competition in electrical and digital infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in section 3.6 as a key factor, with language indicating an 'intense and changing' competitive environment. The trend is stable, but the 'Competition' category weighs heavily in sector analysis.

risks.title: Dependence on strategic suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Identified in the risk management system (section 3.6), this risk is expressed with moderate intensity. It is stable but critical for industrial continuity. The 'Industrial' category is central for Legrand.

risks.title: Rapid evolution of smart building technologies
risks.score_rationale: This risk is central to Legrand's strategy (e.g., Eliot, Weoz), with strong language on the acceleration of change. It is increasing, and the 'Technology' category is strategic. High ranking in the 10-K.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of connected solutions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of connected solutions (e.g., Eliot), with concern expressed over growing threats. Trend is upward, high weight in technology risks. Explicitly positioned in risk management.

risks.title: Increasing regulation on eco-design and energy efficiency
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well positioned within ESG commitments and the 2025-2027 roadmap. Language is firm regarding regulatory obligations. Trend is upward, high weight in sustainable strategy.

risks.title: Successful integration of acquisitions in strategic segments
risks.score_rationale: This risk is recurring in external growth announcements (9 acquisitions in 12 months). Language is cautious regarding synergies. Trend is stable, but critical for development strategy.

risks.title: Protection and valuation of intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in product innovation (e.g., Céliane, Weoz), but not clearly articulated. Language is moderate. Trend is stable. Moderate weight in technology risks.

ai_positioning.summary: Legrand is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its smart building management solutions, without making it a primary strategic driver. AI is used to optimize energy consumption and enhance user experience.
evidence: Deployment of digital solutions with predictive algorithms for maintenance
Integration of smart sensors into energy management systems
Partnerships with AI-focused startups for energy efficiency
